createTable.remarks: Interventions: fixed motivational messages shown above the Suggestions; id 0 is the no-Intervention arm of the experiment; an id names one wording forever

column.name: id
column.remarks: The Intervention id, assigned by hand

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether this Intervention is assigned to new assessments; deactivating all of them turns the experiment off

column.name: text_en
column.remarks: The text in English, the fallback for the other languages; null only for the no-Intervention arm

column.name: text_nl
column.remarks: The text in Dutch

column.name: text_el
column.remarks: The text in Greek

column.name: text_lt
column.remarks: The text in Lithuanian

createTable.remarks: The Intervention assigned to one assessment of a user; records what was assigned, not what was displayed

column.name: assessment_id
column.remarks: The assessment id, generated by the backend and returned to the client

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: The user who requested the assessment

column.name: application_id
column.remarks: Application id

column.name: intervention_id
column.remarks: The assigned Intervention

column.name: ui_lang
column.remarks: The language of the Intervention text sent to the client

column.name: recipe_url
column.remarks: Recipe URL as supplied for assessment

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: The time of the assignment

createTable.remarks: The Suggestions shown under an Intervention Assignment

column.name: intervention_assignment_assessment_id
column.remarks: The Intervention Assignment

column.name: suggestion_template_id
column.remarks: The Suggestion shown

createTable.remarks: Suggestion Events: an append-only log of the accept/reject transitions a user made on the Suggestions of an Intervention Assignment

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key

column.name: intervention_assignment_assessment_id
column.remarks: The Intervention Assignment under which the Suggestion was shown

column.name: suggestion_template_id
column.remarks: The Suggestion the user acted on

column.name: action
column.remarks: The transition: INCREASE_ACCEPTED, DECREASE_ACCEPTED, INCREASE_REJECTED or DECREASE_REJECTED

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: The time of the transition
